q1.explanationZh: 第一段说他们一共划了超过 14,000 公里，所以选 14,000 kilometres。

evidence.quote: Altogether, they travelled more than 14,000 kilometres.

q2.explanationZh: 第二段说食物不够时，他们得更用力地划，早点到岸上拿食物。所以是少吃一点、划得更快。

evidence.quote: Food once ran low. They had to row harder to reach land to get food.

q3.explanationZh: 第四段说他们还筹到 160 多万美元，要给 4 万人带去干净的水。

evidence.quote: They also raised more than $1.6 million.

q4.explanationZh: 最后一段兄弟俩说“We feel happy but really tired”，就是高兴但是累坏了。

evidence.quote: We feel happy but really tired.

q5.explanationZh: 文章讲了三兄弟破纪录的经过，也讲了筹款和他们的收获，所以是报道破纪录的旅程和它的意义。

evidence.quote: Recently, three brothers set a world record by rowing across the Pacific Ocean.
